scope: Xbox 360 Xenia Edge in-Nougat viewport embedding repair
runtime_requirement: Existing components/games/runtime/xenia/xenia_edge_linux.AppImage from the previously verified Xenia Edge installation.
architecture: Create an X11 proxy identified as xenia_canary with _NET_WM_PID set to the launched Edge process PID.
Nougat v53's existing EmulatorHost selects and reparents the proxy into its native Games/player viewport.
The launcher waits until that capture is confirmed before starting Xenia Edge.
The helper finds only the official Edge top-level X11 client from the launched process tree and reparents it inside the already-embedded proxy.
Nougat continues tracking/resizing the proxy, while the helper keeps Edge sized to the proxy.

validation.xvfb_integration_test: PASS: mock Nougat host captured proxy; mock Xenia top-level parent became proxy; wrapper and helper exited 0.
